  {"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7068,"var":"ctxt","code":"xmlParseReference(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt)","note":"The parser reaches an attacker-controlled entity reference in document content."},
  {"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7398,"var":"cur","code":"cur = ent->children;","note":"The cached entity subtree is taken from the entity declaration for reuse."},
  {"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7399,"var":"ent->children","code":"ent->children = NULL;","note":"The entity loses ownership of the cached subtree, so later operations work on detached nodes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7400,"var":"last","code":"last = ent->last;","note":"The tail pointer is preserved locally so the loop can walk the detached list after the entity fields are cleared."},
  {"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7402,"var":"cur->next","code":"cur->next = NULL;","note":"The current node is isolated from the rest of the cached list before copying and reinsertion."},
  {"step":6,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7403,"var":"cur->parent","code":"cur->parent = NULL;","note":"The detached node is unlinked from its original parent, leaving namespace resolution dependent on stale source-tree state."},
  {"step":7,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7404,"var":"nw","code":"nw = xmlDocCopyNode(cur, ctxt->myDoc, 1);","note":"The detached node is copied into the parser document, which invokes xmlStaticCopyNode and its namespace lookup logic."},
  {"step":8,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4282,"var":"node->ns","code":"ns = xmlSearchNs(node->doc, node, node->ns->prefix);","note":"The copy path dereferences the source node's namespace prefix and can read stale or freed namespace data after the entity subtree has been detached and reused."}
]
EOF
